title: CLOSINGBALANCEWEEK of a month uses the last day of the week of its last date, after the month's end

source.quote: CLOSINGBALANCEWEEK uses the last date of the week that contains the last date in the filter context. This date can be after the end of the month.

derivation: The last date of August 2008 is Sunday August 31, in W36-2008 (August 31 to September 6). Its last date, September 6, has Amount 6.
